messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the production-clearance checklist for Dedicated GA. Major open areas: SLA tiers + enforcement, docs/runbooks, support coverage, monitoring SLOs, pricing guardrails. Who can own the SLA doc?

alex: I can take SLA doc. Initial thought: separate tiers (dev/free, standard, enterprise). Propose enterprise availability target 99.95% and standard 99.9%. We should also spell out automatic fallback behaviors (model variant, region).

priya: From runtime side, 99.95 is doable if we allow fallback to smaller model and cross-region failover. Need to explicitly document expected quality deltas when fallback occurs.

jordan: Docs/comms — I'll draft a "what to expect" and "degradation modes" section. Need concrete SLA wording + example incidents to avoid legal ambiguity.

sam: Pricing note — we need a burst backstop for GA customers. Suggest committed burst blocks and overage priced at 1.5x regular rate until capacity scales. Also draft credit schedule tied to availability.

maria: Monitoring owners: define SLOs and alert thresholds. My proposal: 95th token latency SLO, 99th token latency SLO (for p95/p99 reporting), and error-rate SLO < 0.1% per minute. Alerts: p99 latency > target for 10m, error rate > 0.3% for 5m. Add runbooks.

alex: Runbook stub to include: ```pager -> oncall -> triage -> identify regression -> escalate to infra if not resolved in 15m -> consider rollback``` I'll add details and contact list.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled oncall shift starts at 4199012350 — alex (primary).

priya: Add the synthetic-smoke plan: create a synthetic traffic pipeline hitting all regions every 5m, compare QoE against baseline. If QoE delta > 10% persist for 3 checks -> paged alert. Will add PR with terraform.

jordan: Support model: 24/7 critical incident support for GA customers, business-hours for non-critical for first 90 days. We should prepare canned responses and escalation templates.

maria: Rollback criteria we should encode now: KPI degradation >20% sustained for 10m, or error-rate spike >0.5% for any region -> trigger automatic rollback and notify SRE + PMs. Agree?

alex: Agree. Also propose canary rollout policy: 5% for 2h, 25% for 12h, 100% after healthy metrics. Will document the gating checks.

priya: Don't forget to document model-compatibility caveats (quantized vs fp16 variants). Add expected perf +/- ranges.

sam: Commercial: SLA credit table required in contract. Finance needs to sign off on the numbers before GA freeze. I'll draft and sync with legal.

maria: Action items: alex — SLA doc by EOD tomorrow; jordan — docs draft (customer-facing + internal) by Wed; priya — monitoring/canary + synthetic smoke plan by Mon; sam — pricing/backstop + credit table by Thu. I'll compile everything into the release handoff spreadsheet once items are in.

jordan: Looping in legal for SLA credit language (will ping @legal). Will also prepare the customer-facing FAQ about expected performance during fallback.

alex: Uploading initial SLA draft to Drive: https://drive.example.com/sla-draft (WIP). Please leave comments.

priya: Instrumentation PR #1234 open — adds p99 token latency and per-model QoE. Please review before EOD.

maria: Good progress. If we hit owners' deadlines, plan a dry-run next week and freeze GA handoff. No major blockers flagged now. :thumbsup:
